answer: Because of that, capturing the pool requires several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. The ripple cap is applied at the ember settlement and visible in the umber breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. A single identity may take at most 12% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
